children: Iron ore prices are lower in early Asian trade, weighed by ample supply and subdued demand, analysts at CITIC Futures write in a note. Although port inventories declined, the drawdown was smaller than expected, while falling hot-metal output and weaker steel mill profitability are limiting the recovery in consumption, they add. The most actively traded January iron ore contract on the Dalian Commodity Exchange is 0.5% lower at CNY654.5 a ton. (jiahui.huang@wsj.com; @ivy_jiahuihuang)
